notices.author: Oakrun Watch
notices.body: The North Road remains open, but travellers should not pass the boundary stones alone. Report strange tracks to the watch.

notices.author: Carriage Yard
notices.body: The covered carriage is being readied for longer routes. Destinations and fares will be posted here when service begins.

notices.author: Wayfarer's Rest
notices.body: Hot supper at dusk. Muddy boots by the door, blades peace-bound inside.

notices.author: Floodwarden Office
notices.body: Falling water reveals roads and hazards together. White chalk marks expire at the next bell. The Crown does not certify red or yellow routes.

notices.author: Lina Pell
notices.body: Names, return addresses, and household letters ride uphill free on Mudwheel. Tie bundles in red cord. Absence is not death.

notices.author: Pava Mirek
notices.body: Roof hands who can brace wet timber: meet at the salvage crane before second light. Bring your own rule. Do not bring theories about my brother.

notices.author: Unsigned
notices.body: When the third low wick gutters, the road is passable once. Anyone promising safer terms is selling somebody else's rope.

notices.author: House of Names
notices.body: The memorial records Drazna's first verified public account. It does not certify a birthplace. Corrections with dated sources are heard on Birch Heights.
